state.question: Has Estuary Works's operating change resolved the question about water quality compliance? Focus on: September compliant drinking-water samples as a share of tested samples under the same limit.

candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Estuary Works's strategy in water quality compliance, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.abstract: Estuary Works features in a field guide to water quality compliance. The worked example draws on a separate setting: an equipment catalogue lists compliance badges without sample results.
